name: tora_idle
desc: Pixel art game sprite of a big muscular paint monster shaped like a tiger man, exactly the character in the front and side view references: brown paint body with broad diagonal cream bands and a few thin golden streaks, paint dripping from the arms, thighs and tail, pointed ears with light inner fur, short spiky brown hair, light cheek fur, thick dark eyebrows, a dark mark on the forehead, brown eyes, a wide, flat dark brown nose that is much wider than it is tall, with an almost straight top edge, the underside curving in from both sides to a short soft point, and two small nostrils at its lower corners, the space between the nose and the mouth plain smooth brown, calm closed-mouth smile, a long thick tail with a cream band, straight human-shaped legs with bare human feet, arms hanging relaxed at his sides. Three-quarter view facing left, standing idle pose. Same pixel art style and size as the reference crocodile sprite: dark outline, glossy highlights, drips.
